defendant: Ocean Bay 500 LLC, and Joseph Hoffman
description:
Nearest Cross Street: West 3rd Street
Approximate Dimensions of the property: 50' X 85'
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by Plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interests remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
The property is being sold subject to any and all possessory interests and/or leases, if any, affecting the premises not made party defendants. The property is subject to certain easements and restrictions of record. The property is vacant
The sale of this property is subject to the following:
1. Tax Sale Certificate #24-00007 with an approximate balance due of $2,841.22 plus interest*;
2, Third Quarter Taxes in the amount of $357.58 plus interest*; and
3. Five (5) judgments against a predecessor in title in varying amounts entered on various dates with none of them exceeding a judgment amount of $1,500.00.
*Redemption figures and additional interest figures can be obtained from the Tax collector's Office for the Borough of Keyport.
All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interests remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon. The purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagee or agent of the Mortgagee’s attorneys. If the sale is set aside for any reason the purchaser at the sale shall be entitled to only a return of the deposit paid. The purchaser shall have no further recourse against the mortgagor; the mortgagee or the mortgagee’s attorney.
As the above description does not constitute a full legal description, said full legal description can be found at the Monmouth County Sheriff’s office is annexed to certain mortgages as follows:
1. Recorded on February 16, 2023 in the Office of the Clerk of Monmouth County as instrument #2023011437 and the Writ of Execution on file with the Sheriff of Monmouth County.
The Approximate anticipated upset price and amount to be satisfied by the sale of this property is $62,500.00.
1. Plaintiff's title company Old Republic has issued an Indemnification Agreement concerning certain judgments. The judgment search and Indemnification Agreement are available for informational purposes only and upon request by contacting Foss, San Filippo & Milne, LLC at 225 Broad Street, P.O. Box 896, Red Bank, New Jersey 07701 732-741-2525
